title: Synthetic ImagePullBackOff alert
summary: Synthetic image pull alert for benchmark; no real registry request is made by this fixture.
evidence: Ground truth: Kubernetes cannot fetch the requested image because the synthetic image reference is invalid or unavailable. Image: example.invalid/benchmark/worker:does-not-exist. No real credentials included.

ground_truth.root_cause: The pod cannot start because its configured container image cannot be pulled (invalid or unavailable image reference).
